Heir to the chivalric tradition, '''Discipline''' is a [[knights|knightly]] skill that may be thought of as having three distinct parts. The first part, Falconry, involves the raising, training, and use of [[falcons]]. The second part of Chivalry is [[archery]]. By gaining the abilities to assess wind direction and speed and use different kinds of [[bows|weapons]] (longbows, crossbows, darkbows) you may attack from afar, or shoot at a cowardly opponent who has fled to the skies. The third and final part of Chivalry involves an assortment of aggressive abilities ranging from howling a Battlecry, to Engaging your unlucky opponent, to boosting your prowess with Fury.

The skill of Discipline is available only to members of the [[Runewarden]] [[class]], although most of its arts are shared with the [[Dominion]], [[Malignity]], and [[Valour]] skills of the [[Unnamable]], [[Infernal]], and [[Paladin]] classes. Like the other warrior-classes, Runewardens train in [[Weaponmastery]], but the ideographic skill of [[Runelore]] is unique to them.


==Abilities in Discipline==
{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Falcon
 |description=Use the basic skills to interact with your falcon.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=FALCON
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=
 |detail=The art of Falconry is a noble one indeed. It is a sport reserved solely for those of chivalrous breeding, for a bird as noble as the falcon would never respond to commands given by one without honour.<p>When you initially gain Falconry, the first thing you must do is find a hatchery. At the hatchery, FALCON REQUEST.</p><p>Hatcheries are located in:<br>* the Mhojave desert near the Ruins of el'Jazira<br>- the Ashtan resource hub<br>- the Cyrene resource hub<br>- the Eleusian resource hub<br>- the Hashan resource hub<br>- the Mhaldor resource hub<br>- the Targossas resource hub<br>- the manor of the Grand Merchant Collective, in Delos<br>(*) this is the only public hatchery.</p><p>Each hatchery gives out a different breed of falcon. The breeds vary in appearance only: capabilities are identical. </p><p>Your falcon comes to you with assorted statistics which have been randomly assigned. </p><p>If you cause your falcon to die, you will be refused another falcon. There is absolutely no excuse for killing or conspiring to kill your falcon. </p><p>Below is a list of commands that may be used once you have gotten your falcon. </p><p>FALCON ASSESS : See information about your falcon.<br>FALCON RECALL : Recall your falcon to your wrist. Requires a falconry glove. <br>FALCON SANCTUARY : Order your falcon to a sanctuary where it will be safe. <br>FALCON LAND : Order your falcon to land on the ground.<br>FALCON CIRCLE : Order your falcon to fly up into the skies.<br>FALCON TRAIN : Order your falcon to go train, in order to raise a stat. <br>FALCON REPORT : Gain information on where your falcon is.<br>FALCON SLAY : Order your falcon to slay someone.<br>FALCON HUNT : When your falcon is hungry, have it go hunt for its food. <br>FALCON FLEE : Set the amount of health remaining when your falcon will flee battle. <br>FALCON SLEEP : Order your falcon to sleep.<br>FALCON FEED RAT : Feed the corpses of rats to your falcon.</p><p>As your falcon gains in<br>'''Stamina''': its health will increase.<br>'''Speed''': it will attack more quickly as well as fly from place to place more quickly. <br>'''Strength''': it will attack with more power as well as be able to carry larger items.</p>
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Quivers
 |description=Take full advantage of your quiver.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=ENVENOM ARROW[S] [number of arrows] <colour> <venom><br>INSPECT QUIVER<br>DYE <number of arrows> ARROW[S] <colour><br>SWITCH <colour>
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=
 |detail=Your mastery of quivers allows you to dye and envenom arrows from vials in your possession to be stored in your quiver.<p>When envenoming arrows, if a number of arrows is provided, you will dye and envenom that number of undyed arrows the colour and venom selected. Otherwise, you will coat all your arrows of the selected colour with the venom of your choice. </p><p>Inspecting your quiver will show you how many of each colour arrow you possess and what venoms they have been covered with. </p><p>Further, you may dye any number of undyed arrows the colour of your choice. However, you will find yourself unable to do so if you have arrows of that colour envenomed within your quiver.</p><p>Colours you may use are red, blue, purple, green, black, white, grey, orange, gold, and silver.</p><p>To switch to using a specific colour of arrow, simply SWITCH <colour>. If you wish to switch back to using undyed arrows, simply do SWITCH NORMAL.</p>
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Fury
 |description=Temporarily raise your strength.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=FURY [ON/OFF]<br>RELAX FURY
 |required=
 |target=Self
 |cooldown=2.00 seconds of equilibrium
 |detail=This will allow you to temporarily raise your strength with 2 points, for no more than a total of 1/4th of each Achaean day. It can be used once a day without cost, but if you turn it off and turn it back on within the same Achaean day, you will incur a cost of 500 willpower each time you turn it back on. Your endurance losses will be significantly higher while Fury is active.
}}
